g.text: Frozen prompts · Few-shot count and measured token share
Shapes: few-shot count. Colour: measured output / (input + output) on a shared observed scale.
Quality is Macro-F1 for Bios and accuracy otherwise. Cost uses configured token prices, not HPC charges.
